data.name: Apsara
data.gender_notes: Apsara is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Apsaras are celestial nymphs and attendants to the gods. They are depicted as beautiful, graceful, and skilled dancers who bring joy and harmony in the heavens. The name Apsara carries the meaning “Celestial nymph, heavenly dancer” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Apsara usually hope their child will grow to embody celestial nymph, heavenly dancer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of grace, beauty, and divine inspiration
data.etymology: Apsara belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Celestial nymph, heavenly dancer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Apsara total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: Apsaras are an integral part of Hindu art, literature, and folklore. They are often portrayed in temple carvings, rock-cut monasteries, classical dance performances, and dramas, including the ancient Indian epic, the Mahabharata. Their presence adds a sense of ethereal beauty and grace to these cultural expressions, reflecting the rich religious and artistic heritage of India.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, Apsaras represent the divine feminine energy or Shakti. They symbolize the creative, nurturing, and enchanting aspects of the universe, embracing the concepts of love, joy, and spiritual upliftment. As attendants to the gods, their celestial presence is believed to bring peace, harmony, and blessings to the world. When named 'Apsara', one may be reminded to embody these qualities and strive towards spiritual growth and inner beauty.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Apsaras are celestial nymphs in Hindu mythology, gracing heavens with their enchanting beauty and mesmerizing dance. Symbolizing grace, art, and sensuality, they are believed to inspire creativity and bring joy.
